strategy.overview: Metal Man rewards repeat castle collections and laps around its long loop. Complete the drop bank to advance the castle awards, then shoot a lit castle saucer twice: the first visit prepares its sequence and the next collects it. Loop laps build toward extra-ball and 500,000-point awards.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the drop bank to advance the castle awards, then shoot a lit castle saucer twice: once to prepare it and again to collect it. Keep shooting the long loop; three laps light extra ball at the lower-right lane, and five laps add extra ball plus 500,000 points at the hole.
strategy.summary: Complete the drop bank to advance the castle awards. Shoot a lit castle saucer once to prepare it and again to collect it. Make three loop laps to light the lower-right extra ball; five laps add extra ball plus 500,000 at the hole.

quickInfo.name: Castle awards
quickInfo.summary: Complete the drop bank to advance the available castle prizes.

quickInfo.name: Collect a castle prize
quickInfo.summary: Shoot its lit saucer once to prepare the sequence, then return for the award.

quickInfo.name: Three laps
quickInfo.summary: Lights extra ball at the lower-right lane.

quickInfo.name: Five laps
quickInfo.summary: Adds extra ball and 500,000 points at the hole.

steps.text: Complete the drop-target bank to advance the available castle award.
Shoot the corresponding castle saucer once to prepare its sequence, then return to collect the lit award.
Repeat the long loop to build the lap count.
After three laps, collect the lit extra ball at the lower-right lane; after five laps, shoot the hole for extra ball and 500,000 points.

alternatives.title: Build the INDER specials
alternatives.when: Use this when the loop or castle returns are not settling cleanly.

steps.text: Complete the five INDER letters to light the special at the castle and lower target.
Collect whichever lit special presents the safer return on this machine.
Finish the drop bank repeatedly; its first three completions progress from 100,000 to extra ball to special at the associated target.
Use loop shots between bank completions so the lap awards advance at the same time.
Return to a prepared castle saucer to cash the current prize before building the next one.

machineSetup: Confirm how extra ball and special are configured before competitive play; several central routes award them directly.
Test the drop bank, long loop, castle saucers, launcher, lower-right lane, and lap counter before relying on the repeat route.

cautions.issue: The exact value collected from a castle saucer depends on which prize its drop-bank progress has lit.
cautions.response: Read the lit insert before shooting; use the repeat-visit rule for the physical collection and let the machine identify the current award.
